message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r7g -- "the same viewer" only from reads that worked: a failed pull, a host log shorter than at the pick or not continuing it, a lost marker are "cannot tell" -> no tap

Codex codex_old_apk_lane_src_r7d_r2.md N2 / verifier r7g (seq16123 6). 9cec590's same_viewer read since() and host_log(),
which turn a failed read into '' -- so no scene / status / host end was seen and it said True. Test lane only.

- applog_snapshot() / host_snapshot(): (ok, text) of a read known to have worked (the pull and the file read; this run's
  readiness and its host log), else (False, why). applog() / host_log() are unchanged for their other callers.
- set_pick_mark(): the marker is registered only from two good reads -- the app log's last line (non-empty) and the host
  log's length + the sha256 of everything up to it; else 3 FAILs ("no marker could be taken").
- same_viewer(): no app snapshot / the marker gone from the app log / no host snapshot / the host log shorter than at the
  pick / its first part not what it was (replaced) -> (False, "cannot tell"). 4's tap and the 3w watch both use it.

Tests (stub): oa_pick_test 64/64 -- after the pick: pull fails / host log shrinks / host log replaced / marker lost ->
4 FAIL with no tap; during the watch: pull fails / host log shrinks -> 3w FAIL, no input; the marker refused from a failed
pull and from an empty host log; unchanged good reads -> True (control); contrast: 9cec590's same_viewer said True with
the pull failing. Arm P from its start (auto_login NO_CREDENTIAL, manual connect) through 2k / 2s / 3 / 3s / 3w to a 4
FAIL: no tap after it (no menu, no disconnect), 5 6 7 NOT RUN (the fake gains the P start / manual / connect scenes and
a failing pull). No real run.
